description: ODC: module image created by the verbs. The content (Byte[] binary of IESpace.CreateImage) goes in the args as base64 text, a 1x1 PNG; before, the verb had no conversion to Byte[] ('Invalid cast from System.String to System.Byte[]') and without the arg the platform refused ('Image binary cannot be null'). The get reads back Width/Height 1 and OriginalFormat Png. The locale (IESpace.GetOrCreateLocale, its only factory) is also born by create, and a second create of the same culture returns the SAME key. The localized image (ILocalizedImage) does not exist in ODC: tests/jobs-odc-negative/localized-image-reactive.json.

ops._why: Width 1, Height 1, OriginalFormat Png, ImageContent with the 70 bytes
